name: desmoslock
description: Locked-down Desmos graphing calculator for exams. Teacher-controlled kiosk lock, Electron client, desmoslock.com landing page.

scripts.install:all: npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix desktop install
scripts.publish:installers: mkdir -p web/downloads && cp desktop/dist/*.dmg desktop/dist/*.exe desktop/dist/*.AppImage web/downloads/ 2>/dev/null || true
